prompt:
Research the officially documented context window and output token limits of the current Claude and GPT model families. Cite the vendors' own documentation pages and quote the limits.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

If you're not sure about something, just say so.

response.content:
Here is a summary of my findings based on the official documentation, followed by the strictly formatted source lines you requested.

**Analysis Summary:**
For **Claude** (Anthropic), the current flagship models (Opus 4.x, Sonnet 4.x, Haiku 4.5) feature a 1M-token context window. Output limits are bifurcated: standard synchronous API calls allow up to 64K or 128K tokens depending on the model, while the Batch API (a beta feature) allows up to 300K tokens for specific high-capacity models (Opus 4.8/4.7/4.6, Sonnet 5/4.6).

For **GPT** (OpenAI), I was unable to retrieve official documentation regarding context window or output limits for current models (e.g., GPT-4o, GPT-4.5, o1) from the provided search results. The search results focused exclusively on Anthropic’s Claude platform. Therefore, I have marked the GPT-specific limits as not found.

**Required Output Lines:**

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview?f80ce999_sort_date=desc | QUOTE: "Context window: 1M tokens | Max output: 128K tokens | Input pricing: $4 / MTok · Output pricing: $20 / MTok" | CLAIM: This table documents that Claude Opus 5.5 (a current model) has a 1M-token context window and a maximum output limit of 128K tokens.
SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/overview | QUOTE: "Max output: 128K tokens" | CLAIM: Confirms the maximum output token limit for Claude Opus 5.5 on the standard API.
SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview?f80ce999_sort_date=desc | QUOTE: "Max output (Batch API, beta): 300K tokens" | CLAIM: Documents that certain Claude models (Opus 5.5, Opus 5, Sonnet 5.5, Sonnet 5, Haiku 5.5, Opus 4.8/4.7/4.6, Sonnet 4.6) support up to 300K output tokens when using the Message Batches API with a beta header.
SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows | QUOTE: "Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, Claude Fable 5, Claude Mythos 5, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Claude Mythos Preview have a 1M-token context window." | CLAIM: Lists the specific Claude model identifiers that feature a 1M-token context window.
SOURCE: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8606395-how-large-is-the-claude-api-s-context-window | QUOTE: "The Claude API can ingest 1M tokens when using Claude Fable 5, Opus 5, Opus 4.8, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6, Sonnet 5, or Sonnet 4.6, and 200K+ tokens (about 500 pages of text or more) when using all other models." | CLAIM: Provides a high-level distinction in context window size between the 1M-tier models and older/other models (200K+).
SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview?f80ce999_sort_date=desc | QUOTE: "Context window | 1M tokens" | CLAIM: From the capabilities table for Claude Opus 5.5, confirming the context window size.
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: Official OpenAI documentation detailing context window limits for current GPT models (e.g., GPT-4o, GPT-4.5, GPT-4 Turbo, o1).
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: Official OpenAI documentation detailing maximum output token limits for current GPT models.
